DepthCells.meaning: clearing cells carrying both prediction depth and the recommended placement

DepthAurocAll.meaning: mean AUROC of prediction depth over the clearing cells

DepthMinusPsbdAuroc.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta, prediction depth minus PSBD, all clearing cells

DepthMinusPsbdTpr.meaning: mean paired low-budget TPR delta, prediction depth minus PSBD, all clearing cells

DepthMinusPsbdTprHard.meaning: mean paired low-budget TPR delta on the hard attacks

DepthMinusPsbdAurocHard.meaning: mean paired AUROC delta on the hard attacks

DepthTprWins.meaning: clearing cells where prediction depth beats PSBD at the low budget

DepthBenignAuroc.meaning: mean prediction-depth AUROC on the 4 benign references
